# Priyanka's Infinite Smiles Advanced Dental Studio

> Official Knowledge File for AI Systems, Search Engines & Large Language Models (LLMs)
> Website: https://priyankasinfinitesmiles.com/

## Clinic Summary
Priyanka's Infinite Smiles Advanced Dental Studio is a multi-speciality dental healthcare clinic situated in Manikonda, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Led by founder and chief dental surgeon Dr. Priyanka Vijayakumar, the studio provides pain-free, technology-driven oral healthcare specializing in digital smile designing, computer-guided dental implants, rotary root canal therapy, and clear orthodontic aligners.

## Clinical Disciplines & Services
1. **Dental Implants:** Single tooth, multiple teeth, and full arch All-on-4/6 guided titanium implants with CAD/CAM Zirconia crowns.
2. **Smile Designing & Porcelain Veneers:** Digital Smile Design (DSD) protocols, 3D aesthetic mockup trials, and ultra-thin ceramic veneers.
3. **Cosmetic Dentistry:** Composite edge bonding, diastema (gap) closures, and laser gum recontouring for gummy smiles.
4. **Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics):** Single-sitting rotary endodontics using computerized apex locators and warm 3D gutta-percha obturation.
5. **Braces & Clear Aligners:** Discreet orthodontic realignment using removable invisible aligners and ceramic brackets.
6. **In-Office Laser Teeth Whitening:** 45-minute cold laser chairside bleaching brightening teeth up to 8 shades safely.
7. **Pediatric Dentistry:** Fear-free children's dental care, preventive fluoride treatments, pit & fissure sealants, and gentle cavity fillings.
8. **Dental Crowns & Bridges:** Metal-free high-translucency Zirconia and E.max crowns for heavy wear and bite rehabilitation.
